# cpanel_notification_preferences (Resource)

Manages the complete cPanel account notification preference map. Removing the resource restores the complete settings observed when Terraform first took ownership.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "cpanel_notification_preferences" "account" {
  preferences = {
    notify_account_authn_link                           = true
    notify_account_authn_link_notification_disabled     = true
    notify_contact_address_change                       = true
    notify_contact_address_change_notification_disabled = true
    notify_disk_limit                                   = true
    notify_password_change                              = true
    notify_password_change_notification_disabled        = true
    notify_ssl_expiry                                   = true
    notify_twofactorauth_change                         = true
    notify_twofactorauth_change_notification_disabled   = true
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `preferences` (Map of Boolean) The complete notification preference map returned by cPanel. The configured key set must exactly match the account's available preference names.

### Read-Only

- `account` (String) The singleton account identity, always `account`.
- `descriptions` (Map of String) Localized descriptions keyed by notification preference name.
- `restore_preferences` (Map of Boolean) The complete preference map that Terraform restores when the resource is removed.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import cpanel_notification_preferences.account account
```
